turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have twenty minutes to explain why my son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class. Who decided that, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
Before I came in. That's today, Hale, and the zero went in a week ago. I asked whether anyone heard Owen before that mark was entered.
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.

Then she'll put it in writing, and I'll read it. Policy is policy, you said, so check yours: section 4.2 says you contact me before any mark goes in, and nobody called me. I'm writing down that you haven't answered whether Owen was heard first.
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.
A courtesy. I'm writing that down, Hale. Withdraw the zero today, or I'm in the principal's office before my call.
